item.title: Puerto Rico Air National Guard announces new chief of staff-air
item.description: The Puerto Rico Air National Guard announced the promotion of Col. Steve L. Campbell to brigadier general and his appointment as chief of staff-air during a ceremony at Muñiz Air National Guard Base on Feb. 6, 2026.

item.title: Army’s newest obstetrics and gynecology nurses answer the call to provide comprehensive women’s health services
item.description: Ten Army nurses earned their Area of Concentration designator in obstetrics and gynecology after completing the Carl R. Darnall Army Medical Center’s Nursing Specialty Course, during a graduation ceremony Feb. 9.

item.title: Corpus Christi Army Depot Launches First Organic Composite Blade Repair Program
item.description: CCAD has launched the first organic composite repair program for helicopter blades in the United States.

item.title: WBAMC Graduates 25 From PNC Course
item.description: Twenty-five Soldiers joined the Army's medical ranks as 68C Practical Nurses following a graduation ceremony held at the NCO Leadership Center of Excellence on Thursday, February 12, 2026. These new nurses are now prepared to provide critical and compassionate care for the nation's warfighters both on and off the battlefield.

item.title: Portfolio Acquisition Fires Activates Three Capability Program Executives (CPEs)
item.description: The U.S. Army activated its first Capability Program Executives for Defensive Fires, Offensive Fires, and Integrated Fires during a ceremony hosted by Lt. Gen. Frank Lozano, Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Fires, at Redstone Arsenal, Huntsville, Alabama, Feb. 17, 2026.

item.title: Readout of SOUTHCOM Commander Gen. Francis L. Donovan’s meeting with Venezuelan interim authorities
item.description: The commander of U.S. Southern Command, Marine Gen. Francis L. Donovan, Chargé d’Affaires to the Venezuela Affairs Unit, Ambassador Laura F. Dogu, and U.S. Acting Assistant Secretary of War for Homeland Defense and the Americas Joseph M. Humire met with Venezuelan interim authorities in Caracas February 18, 2026.

item.title: 75th USARIC's HHD conducts FY27 YTB
item.description: 75th U.S. Army Reserve Innovation Command’s Headquarters and Headquarters Detachment commander and first sergeant provided their fiscal year 2027 annual training brief to Maj. Gen. Michelle Link, commanding general, 75th USARIC, and to her command staff both virtually and in-person at Ellington Field Joint Reserve Base, in Houston, Texas, Jan. 24, 2026.

item.title: USO celebrates 10th anniversary on JBER
item.description: The USO marked 10 years of providing services at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson Feb. 11, recognizing a decade of support to service members and their families across the installation.

item.title: 72 Years Strong: ROK-US Alliance honored at symposium and dinner reception
item.description: U.S. military and Republic of Korea soldiers, city officials and community members gathered for a symposium and dinner reception to commemorate the 72nd anniversary of the ROK-US Alliance, highlighting more than seven decades of shared sacrifice, strategic cooperation and unwavering commitment to regional security, Dec. 11, 2025.

item.title: 1st Signal Brigade modernizes Korea network with Army Transport Edge upgrade
item.description: Network modernization completed by 1st Signal Brigade in South Korea.
